_readme: NY_SCH inputs of the parallel test in PRE Paralelo [operator, 2026-10-09]. Copy to the run folder as parallel-test-inputs.json. Every <...> is an OPEN point.
gbo_environment: <ask - the GBO environment running in parallel>
dates: <ask - every business day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD>
gbo_filter: <ask - the branch's rows in GBO (SQL condition)>
box_filter: <ask - the branch's rows in BOX (SQL condition)>
signoff: <ask - the sign-off criteria (e.g. no OPEN break for N days in a row)>
